name: Menadiol Sodium Diphosphate
summary: Menadiol Sodium Diphosphate has warning scores that were calculated by a small computer program rather than through human testing [M]. This program gave the drug a medium-risk score of 63 for the liver [M]. It also assigned the drug a low-risk score of 24 for the heart [M]. There are no specific problems, related drug issues, or regulatory warnings reported in the provided records [1][2].
